company.name: Konoom
company.shortDescription: Konoom makes digital location, local search and reputation management easy for any business.
company.description:
Konoom provides a fast and easy way for businesses, chains, and organizations to manage their online presence on leading directories like Google, Apple, Bing, Yahoo, Yandex, Facebook, and more.
​
Konoom is born in 2020, with three friends and set up offices in Istanbul, Munich, and Sarajevo. After rounds of iterations and improvements, we are delivering the most complete digital location management platform that is complemented with the most necessary managed services and add-on offerings.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Undisclosed round raised $216,112, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,821,989 to $1,821,989, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
